description: Split grey stone bleeding cold cyan light from every seam. Golems grow around them and resent the loss.
lore: They arrive split. You do not open one; you find it open, lit from a hollow in the middle by a cold cyan that has no source you can point at and does not go out when you cover it.

There is a standing order on them, older than anyone now working [[lore/the_hard_pieces|the sheds]]: every geode bought, sight unseen, a hundred and sixty in gold, the same price for a fist and for one you need both arms under. Nobody buys stone that way. Stone goes by weight and grade, and this buyer has never asked after either, never haggled, never said what they are for. The crews stopped asking; the money is good and the questions are unpaid. A man at the east weighing-post tried a fake last spring — grey rubble, a hollow cut with a lamp, coloured glass. It was bought. Same price, no comment. He tells it now as a joke. He has also stopped going to the weighing-post himself.
gm_notes: The standing order is the charter mystery from the junk paragraph of The Hard Pieces. Leave the buyer unresolved; the fake being bought at full price is the only fact worth having.
